prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on what you want (UV beds vs. spray tan), where in Charlotte you are, and your budget. I can pull up current top-rated salons near you — but first a couple quick questions so I give a useful recommendation:

- Do you want a spray tan (airbrush / booth) or sunbed/UV tanning?
- Which Charlotte area or ZIP code is most convenient for you?
- Any preferences (budget, organic products, walk‑ins, privacy, packages)?

While you reply, here are fast tips to help you choose the best salon:
- For spray tans: look for before/after photos, technician training/certifications, booth vs. technician-applied, product brands (clearer, streak-free brands like VersaSpa, Mystic are common), and a patch test option.
- For UV tanning: check that beds are well-maintained, bulbs replaced regularly, and staff screen for skin type/medication risks. Note UV tanning increases skin-cancer risk — consider spray tans or topical bronzers if you’re concerned.
- Check recent Google and Yelp reviews, Instagram for real results, and call to ask about pricing and package deals.

If you want, give me your neighborhood/ZIP and whether you prefer spray or UV and I’ll list the top-rated salons near you with short pros/cons and contact info.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
